signal.rationale: The stated order of INR 15.86 crore is firm (purchase order received, 2-month execution) and equals 63.8% of TTM revenue of INR 24.86 crore (size STATED). It is routine in the sense that the company won maize orders of INR 6.5 and 7.3 crore in early 2026, and TTM OPM of 6.0% triggers the thin-margin exception, so it is decided as non-routine. Revenue growth is positive on the packet's annual and quarterly figures (FY2026 +352%, June quarter +59.7%), so it reaches DEEP_RESEARCH, but margin, counterparty concentration and very thin liquidity are open questions.
